method: Calculate from quantities in the stem using weight conversion, IV pump/gravity, dose/concentration, or tablets; compare to keyed option. Unparsed cases are explicitly not verified.

A patient recovering from surgery needs 675 mL of IV fluid infused over 7 hours. The pump is unavailable; the gravity tubing has a drop factor of 10 gtt/mL. At how many gtt/min should the nurse regulate the infusion? Round to the nearest whole drop.
results.explanation: (675 mL × 10 gtt/mL) ÷ (7 × 60 minutes) = 16.07 gtt/min, rounded to 16 gtt/min.
